resources.string: Paste your YouTube Data API v3 key to start finding outlier videos. Your key stays on this device.
Get a free API key (Google Cloud Console)
Aapki key sirf is phone me encrypted save hoti hai. Kisi server pe nahi jaati.
Your key is saved encrypted on this phone only. It is never sent to any server.
How to create a key? (2 min)
Niche ya keyword daalo (e.g. motivation, cooking)
Enter niche or keyword (e.g. motivation, cooking)
Ye results top-viewed search se aate hain, kuch hidden gems miss ho sakte hain. \'Try more\' → time slices se zyada gems milenge.
These results come from top-viewed search, so some hidden gems might be missed. Use \'Try more\' → time slices to uncover more gems.
Is filter combination me koi outlier nahi mila
No outliers found for this filter combination
Subscriber range badhao ya multiplier kam karke dekho.
Try loosening your subscriber or multiplier thresholds.
Abhi tak koi outlier save nahi kiya
Results me kisi bhi card pe 💾 dabake yaha save kar sakte hain. Swipe left karke hata sakte hain.
Tap 💾 on any outlier card in Results to save it here. Swipe left to remove.
Google Cloud → enable YouTube Data API v3 → create key → API restriction: YouTube Data API v3 only. Short detection uses duration + a /shorts URL check and may occasionally be wrong.
Settings me model naam check karo
Check the model name in Settings
